content.short: The Order of the Kraken is a unique, end-of-the-world, futuristic pirate-themed NFT collection with designs.
content.description:
The OTK is foremost a unique, end-of-the-world, futuristic pirate-themed NFT collection built on the Cardano blockchain. The ultimate ambition of the Project is to release a MMORPG game with a distinct Play-to-Own dynamic.

Our NFT collection, and the Project as a whole, draws inspiration from the romance of the Golden Age of Piracy and blends it with a completely fictional and futuristic world created by the founders and to be finally shaped by the OTK community.

Our vision is initially for early Project participants to have the opportunity to collect and curate a variety of NFTs that represent different aspects of the pirate world. The NFT collection aims not only to be visually stunning, but also to build out a rich, pirate-themed immersive experience supported by a continuous and expanding narrative that will allow Project participants to engage, compete and eventually help build, a game world far beyond just the initial collection of NFTs.

Project participants can from the outset expect an experience whereby they will need to carefully strategise and curate their NFT collection to provide them with the best foundation to embark on voyages of discovery for infamy, fortune and adventure as they explore the progressive lore and the world of the Order of the Kraken.

The ultimate ambition of the Project is to release a MMORPG game with a distinct Play-to-Own dynamic.
